How can an office manager keep staff well informed?

document_clean:
Annual Leave Policy

Full-time staff receive 25 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays. Part-time staff receive a proportional amount.

Leave requests must be made at least two weeks in advance through the HR system. No more than two people from the same team may be on leave at once.

Up to five unused days can be carried over to the next year.

The leave year runs from January to December.
